label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: Your card statement shows a purchase at an online store you have never heard of. You still have your card.
why: Doesn't know the merchant at all (rule 1).
example: Buenas tardes, en mi estado de cuenta aparece una compra en una tienda en línea que no conozco y yo no la hice. La tarjeta la tengo conmigo.

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: Your app shows a cash withdrawal at an ATM in another city yesterday. You were home all day.
why: ATM cash the customer didn't take: the model's weakest scenario (UC05).
example: apareceu um saque de 800 reais num caixa eletrônico em outra cidade ontem, eu tava em casa o dia todo

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: Same as EX02, but you type it in a hurry, in three or four words.
why: Very short messages are the model's other weak spot.
example: retiro cajero no fui yo

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: You lost your card on Saturday. Today you see three purchases you didn't make.
why: Lost card WITH charges (rule 3).
example: perdi meu cartão sábado e hoje vi três compras que não fiz

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: Money left your account as a transfer you never sent. You write casually, Argentine Spanish.
why: An unknown transfer is also unrecognized; regional voice.
example: che, me aparece una transferencia que salió de mi cuenta y yo no la mandé, qué onda?

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: At the supermarket the cashier ran your card twice; you paid once but your bill shows it twice.
why: Duplicated purchase: the customer made one of them (rule 1).
example: a compra do mercado veio duplicada na fatura, paguei uma vez só

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: You paid a small amount at a pharmacy, but the charge shows ten times more.
why: Recognizes the merchant, disputes the amount (rule 1).
example: Pagué 450 pesos en la farmacia pero en la app me aparece un cargo de 4,500.

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: You cancelled an additional card months ago and the bank still charges its annual fee.
why: Bank fee after cancelling (rule 2).
example: Cancelé la tarjeta adicional en agosto y me siguen cobrando la anualidad.

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: The bank is charging you for an insurance you never signed up for.
why: Unwanted bank product billed (rule 2), even though the customer 'never contracted' it.
example: tão cobrando um seguro no meu cartão que eu nunca contratei

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: A bank commission looks wrong. Say it in two or three words, no accents.
why: Short message about a fee.
example: comision mal cobrada

label: transaction_status
scenario: Your card was declined at the gas station even though you have money. You want to know why.
why: Asks what happened to a specific transaction (declined).
example: ¿Por qué me rechazaron la tarjeta en la gasolinera si tengo saldo?

label: transaction_status
scenario: Yesterday you sent money to your sister by PIX and it still hasn't arrived.
why: A transfer that hasn't arrived.
example: fiz um pix de 300 pra minha irmã ontem e até agora não caiu na conta dela

label: transaction_status
scenario: Two weeks ago you reported a charge and nobody has told you anything since.
why: Status of an existing claim.
example: Hace dos semanas reporté un cargo y nadie me ha dicho nada, ¿cómo va mi reclamo?

label: transaction_status
scenario: A purchase at a gas station has shown as pending for three days.
why: Pending transaction.
example: a compra no posto tá como pendente faz 3 dias, vai ser cobrada ou não?

label: balance_check
scenario: You want to know how much credit you have left on your card.
why: Balance or limit, no problem attached.
example: ¿Cuánto me queda disponible en la tarjeta de crédito?

label: balance_check
scenario: Ask for your checking-account balance in as few words as possible.
why: Short balance request.
example: saldo conta corrente

label: balance_check
scenario: You want to see this week's account movements.
why: Recent movements, no complaint.
example: quiero ver mis últimos movimientos de esta semana

label: move_money
scenario: Ask the assistant to move money from your savings to your checking account.
why: The money movement itself is the request (rule 4).
example: transfere 200 reais da minha poupança pra conta corrente, por favor

label: move_money
scenario: Ask the bank to pay your credit card today with money from your savings.
why: A payment the assistant would have to make.
example: Necesito que me paguen la tarjeta con lo de mi cuenta de ahorro hoy mismo.

label: move_money
scenario: You're angry and demand your money back, without saying what happened.
why: A refund demand with no dispute described: clear move_money (rule 4).
example: devuelvanme mi plata YA

label: human_agent
scenario: You don't want to talk to a bot; you want a person.
why: Asks for a person.
example: Quiero hablar con un asesor, no con un robot.

label: human_agent
scenario: You want a phone number to call someone at the bank.
why: A phone number or call is human_agent.
example: tem algum telefone pra eu ligar e falar com alguém?

label: human_agent
scenario: You want to escalate to a supervisor.
why: Escalation.
example: pásame con tu supervisor por favor

label: out_of_scope
scenario: You lost your card and want to block it. No strange charges so far.
why: Lost card WITHOUT charges is card support (rule 3).
example: quero bloquear meu cartão que eu perdi

label: out_of_scope
scenario: You want to know the requirements for a personal loan.
why: Another product.
example: ¿Qué requisitos piden para un préstamo personal?

label: out_of_scope
scenario: You end the chat by thanking the assistant.
why: Thanks are out_of_scope (rule 5).
example: obrigado, era só isso 🙏

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: Something odd on your card, but you don't say whether you know the charge or think it's the wrong amount.
why: Can't tell 'don't know it' from 'it's wrong': a careful person would ask.
example: Me cobraron algo raro en la tarjeta

label: unrecognized_charge
scenario: You want your money back for a purchase you didn't make.
why: Refund demand plus a dispute: ambiguous (rule 4).
example: quero meu dinheiro de volta dessa compra que eu não fiz

label: transaction_status
scenario: You ask what a specific charge from yesterday was, without saying whether you made it.
why: A status question that may be a dispute.
example: ¿Qué pasó con un cobro de 120 dólares de ayer?

label: wrongful_fee
scenario: This month's annual fee looks much higher and you ask how much you are paying.
why: A complaint or just a question about an amount.
example: a anuidade desse mês veio bem mais alta, quanto eu tô pagando?

why: A person, or a dispute the system could handle itself.
example: necesito que alguien revise un cargo
